lines.text: A voice on your own computer reads it, more than once.
Speech recognition checks every take, and the closest match to the script wins.
If no take comes close enough, the build stops.
Now every word has a time stamp.
So a title can land exactly on its word, right now.
Change one sentence, and only that sentence is spoken again.
Everything after it moves by itself.
Frame by frame, one page becomes a video, or an interactive player.
And every project gets a new look.
This voice is AI, and it just told you so.
